_readme: Every company named on an archived ivp.com portfolio surface, 2013-2022, read from Common Crawl captures (the Internet Archive excludes ivp.com; decisions.md D8, R1) by scratch/parse-cc-ivp.py. Gen A (2013 to mid-2016): the listing pages' detail cards with the firm's own one-line description and outcome line. Gen B (mid-2016 to 2022, WordPress): the per-company pages with the firm's own Year Invested, Status, Location and Leadership, and the portfolio slider every company page carries. `url` is the CC capture that cites the row: the company's own archived page where one was captured, else the first listing capture naming it. invest_year is the firm's own 'Year Invested' (an anchor, never a stage label).
